title: Minecraft EASY SUGAR CANE FARM 1.21 - No Observer - 550+ Per Hour!
description:
Hello Everybody TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Sugar Cane Farm In Minecraft 1.21

📚This farm is using a new method that doesn't need observers so it's a good option for the first days of playing ( recommended for beginners )
📚This sugar cane farm is simple easy to build and so efficient for beginners, this farm can produce +4500 Sugar Canes per hour! 
📚You can build this farm on the Minecraft servers!
📚By using the hopper minecarts you can collect all sugar canes on your farm, as know The observer-based designs have a problem and that 40-50% of produced sugarcanes will be wasted because the farm can't collect them but in this design, you don't have this problem
